name: TP53_hotspots
description: TP53 cancer hotspot alleles absent from the 1,174-variant TP53 batch ($DRIFT_ARCHIVE_ROOT/TP53), added 2026-10-14. Same construct as that batch, read from its job JSONs: the full-length p53 homotetramer (P04637, 393 aa, chains A-D, every copy mutated), a 21-bp DNA duplex (E/F) and four Zn2+ (G-J), dialect version 4, 25 seeds. Job names keep the batch's form P53_<variant>_with_ZN_and_DNA. G245S, G245D and H179R are already in the batch. These are a hotspot-only stratum: chosen for their cancer frequency, so statistics on the position-sampled batch must exclude them (as KRAS4B's hotspot_only).

chains.note: Homotetramer: one AF3 entity with four ids, so the substitution is in all four copies, as in the existing batch.
